objective: Render country labels from revision-bound WorldStateV2 label jobs, using static placement and glyph GeoJSON only as validated seed caches.
commands: npm.cmd run lint -- src/lib/projection/label-projection-checkpoint.ts src/lib/projection/label-projection-checkpoint.test.ts src/lib/projection/country-label-runtime-projection.ts src/components/map/WorldMap.tsx src/components/layout/GameSetupShell.tsx src/app/page.tsx
notes: The server builds initial label jobs from WorldStateV2 and serializes them through GameSetupShell to WorldMap.
WorldMap initializes label sources empty. Static placement and glyph files are fetched as cache input and projected through current label jobs before source application.

A matching seed placement can be reused for text-only changes, but stale glyph polygons are removed. Geometry changes use the current job anchor as a point fallback. New polygon glyph generation is not wired in this stage.
The existing China debug scenario still mutates map sources directly; its removal or replacement belongs to 11-11. Ongoing committed-state subscription belongs to 11-10.
